value_stream.name: Technology Business Management, IT Financial Management & Cloud FinOps

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), sponsors, OpEx (VS-133 W4065), OCM (VS-134 W4095)

Automation Opportunity: - Benefit auto-reconciliation to GL/FP&A; value-realization dashboards
Controls: - CTL-637: benefit reconciled by Finance; adoption-dependency documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-133 W4065 (benefit), VS-134 W4095 (adoption ROI), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Benefit-overstate risk**: Claimed but unrealized; mitigated by Finance reconciliation and P&L linkage
- **Adoption-gap risk**: Value missed due to low adoption; mitigated by adoption tracking (VS-134)
System Touchpoints: - Benefit register; FP&A (VS-17.4); OpEx benefit (VS-133 W4065); OCM ROI (VS-134 W4095); governance (VS-36)

steps.activity: FinOps Lead maintain the value-realization register per investment (business case W4100 → realized), with owners and timelines, integrated with OpEx benefit tracking (VS-133 W4065)
FinOps Lead/Finance track realized value (revenue, cost, productivity, risk), reconcile to FP&A (VS-17.4), and attribute adoption-dependent value (VS-134 W4095)
FinOps Lead report value realization to the executive/Board (VS-36), flag shortfalls, and feed lessons into future cases (W4100)

workflows.name: IT Cost-to-Serve, Unit Cost & Productivity Ratio Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compute of "define and compute unit economics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-benchmark of "benchmark unit costs internally (trend, by entity) and externally" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-637 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Value Realization & Financial Analytics (PA-135.3).)
- CTL-637: unit-economics definitions governed; reconciliation to GL
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (BI), VS-133 (OpEx cost-out), VS-17.4 (finance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misleading-ratio risk**: Ratios distorted by accounting mix; mitigated by consistent definitions
- **Benchmark-apples risk**: External benchmarks not comparable; mitigated by careful benchmark selection

steps.activity: FinOps Lead/BI define and compute unit economics: IT-spend-%-revenue, cost-per-POS-transaction, cost-per-ecommerce-order, cost-per-store, cost-per-employee, productivity ratios
FinOps Lead/BI benchmark unit costs internally (trend, by entity) and externally, identify outliers/improvement targets
FinOps Lead report unit economics to leadership, drive cost-to-serve reduction (links to VS-133 OpEx), and track improvement

Controls: - CTL-637 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Value Realization & Financial Analytics (PA-135.3).)
- CTL-637: vendor concentration monitored; contractual SLA/value tracking
Cross-references: - links to VS-03 (vendor mgmt), VS-34 (procurement), VS-100 (legal), VS-113 (EA lock-in)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Concentration risk**: Over-dependent on one vendor; mitigated by portfolio diversification and EA (VS-113)
- **Bench-marking-availability risk**: Limited comparable data; mitigated by analyst/network benchmarks

steps.activity: FinOps Lead/Procurement maintain a tech-vendor financial scorecard (spend, price-vs-market, SLA/quality, value delivered, risk), benchmarked to market
FinOps Lead/Procurement use the scorecard at renewal/negotiation (W4111), consolidate spend for leverage, and manage concentration risk
FinOps Lead report vendor financial performance and savings (W4113) to leadership

fields.Volume: Enterprise technology footprint (cloud, DC, devices, telco)

workflows.name: Cloud Carbon & Sustainability Footprint of Technology

Controls: - CTL-637 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Value Realization & Financial Analytics (PA-135.3).)
Cross-references: - links to VS-25 (ESG), VS-120 (energy), VS-99/VS-73 (e-waste), VS-25.3 (reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Cloud emissions data inconsistent; mitigated by provider data and estimation standards
- **Greenwashing risk**: Overstating reduction; mitigated by standards-aligned reporting (VS-25)
System Touchpoints: - Cloud emissions APIs; energy mgmt (VS-120); ESG reporting (VS-25.3); ITAM/e-waste (VS-99/VS-73)

steps.activity: IT/Sustainability measure the technology carbon footprint (cloud provider emissions data, on-prem energy links to VS-120, device lifecycle links to VS-99, e-waste links to VS-73/VS-99)
IT/Sustainability set reduction targets (workload placement, rightsizing W4107, renewable-powered regions, device-lifecycle extension), and act
IT/Sustainability report the technology footprint in ESG reporting (links to VS-25.3), aligned to standards (GRI/SASB), and track progress

fields.Trigger: Monthly close cycle — Technology Financial Month-End

workflows.name: Technology Financial Month-End, Accruals & GL Reconciliation

Controls: - CTL-637: accruals reconciled to invoices; GL posting controls (VS-17)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (close), VS-15 (AP), VS-72 (interentity), VS-21 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accrual-error risk**: Usage-based spend mis-accrued; mitigated by usage data and reconciliation
- **Close-delay risk**: Technology accruals delay the 5-day close; mitigated by automation and SLAs

steps.activity: FinOps Lead/Finance accrue technology costs (usage-based cloud/SaaS not yet invoiced), allocate per TBM (W4097/W4102), and post to GL/COA (VS-17) within the 5-day close (links to VS-17.1)
FinOps Lead/Finance reconcile cloud/SaaS/vendor invoices to accruals and allocations, resolve exceptions, and handle interentity (VS-72)
FinOps Lead/Finance support the financial close (VS-17.1), audit (VS-21), and provide technology-spend reporting

workflows.name: IT Audit & Compliance for Technology Spend

Controls: - CTL-637: technology-spend controls per internal-controls-matrix; audit findings remediated
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-34 (procurement), VS-99 (ITAM/SAM), VS-100 (legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Audit-finding risk**: Non-compliance in tech procurement/spend; mitigated by controls and remediation
- **License-audit risk**: Vendor software audit (under-licensing penalty); mitigated by SAM governance (VS-99)

steps.activity: Audit/IT Finance review technology spend for compliance: procurement policy (VS-34), contract/legal (VS-100), license compliance (VS-99), segregation of duties, and accuracy of TBM allocations
Audit/IT Finance test controls (approval thresholds, vendor onboarding, accrual accuracy, shadow IT W4112), and report findings
IT Finance remediate findings (links to VS-133 OpEx), and track to closure

fields.Trigger: Currency exposure; commitment cycle; risk review
fields.Volume: Enterprise technology commitments (USD-denominated cloud/SaaS, multi-year contracts)

workflows.name: Technology Financial Risk, FX & Commitment Exposure Management

Automation Opportunity: - FX-exposure analytics on tech spend; commitment-portfolio risk modeling
Controls: - CTL-637 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Value Realization & Financial Analytics (PA-135.3).)
- CTL-637: FX hedging per group policy (VS-18); commitment review with Legal/Risk
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury/FX), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-100 (contracts), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **FX-volatility risk**: PHP/USD moves spike cloud/SaaS cost; mitigated by hedging aligned to group policy
- **Commitment-risk**: Multi-year commitment traps spend; mitigated by exit terms and staged commitments

steps.activity: FinOps Lead/Treasury map technology financial exposures: USD-denominated cloud/SaaS (FX), multi-year commitments (commitment/termination risk), vendor concentration, and price-escalation clauses
FinOps Lead/Treasury hedge/manage FX exposure on technology spend (aligned to group FX policy VS-18), manage commitment risk (exit terms, caps), and diversify concentration
FinOps Lead report technology financial risk to risk/treasury governance (VS-21.2/VS-18) and the Board (VS-36)

workflows.name: Annual Technology Financial Review & TBM Maturity Assessment

Controls: - CTL-637 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Value Realization & Financial Analytics (PA-135.3).)
- CTL-637: annual review with Board oversight; independent assurance via Audit (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (performance), VS-36 (governance), VS-21 (audit), VS-17.4 (finance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stagnation risk**: TBM/FinOps plateaus; mitigated by maturity assessment and benchmarking
- **Relevance risk**: TBM detached from strategy; mitigated by annual strategic alignment
System Touchpoints: - TBM (W4097); performance (VS-33); governance (VS-36); benefit (W4113); maturity model

steps.activity: FinOps Lead assess TBM/FinOps maturity (taxonomy, visibility, optimization, governance, value realization) against a maturity model, and benchmark externally
FinOps Lead review the annual program: spend vs budget (W4098), value realized (W4113), unit economics (W4114), maturity gaps, and the forward plan
FinOps Lead present to the Board (VS-36), set next-year targets, and adjust the operating model
